regime_context: Canada/TSX detector shows a broad leadership concentration in precious metals (Silver & Royalties and Gold Miners are ranks 1-2, both eligible, full breadth) with a co-leadership structure — the rotation margin between leader and challenger is only 0.034, so this is NOT a single dominant narrative. Cross-sectional rank is an attention lens only; the one validated leg is the absolute-trend gate, which is helping on this market's history. Given dir_accuracy of 0.31 on 64 prior calls, conviction should be deliberately modest.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Silver & Royalties leadership actually separates from Gold Miners. The rotation margin is only 0.034 and the backtest shows no validated handoff forecast, so the key observable is a CONFIRMED gap: if XGD.TO (silver-heavy proxy) outperforms the broader gold-miner complex by more than 3% over a rolling 10-day window while Silver & Royalties breadth stays at 1.0, that would retire the co-leadership watch and elevate Silver & Royalties to a cleaner single narrative; if instead Gold Miners closes the gap and the margin flips, the watch resolves to a two-legged precious-metals complex with no separating signal.

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties is the top-ranked eligible theme with full breadth (1.0), a durability bar of 0.69 that sits above the market's median, and is not crowded (crowding_z 0.8). It passes the absolute-trend gate (eligible=true), which is the ONE validated leg for staying-power/drawdown control on this market. The lean is a modest trend-following expression, not a return forecast — it mostly reflects that the theme is currently inside the trend discipline with healthy cohesion.
evidence: eligible true (passes absolute-trend gate, the validated leg)
theses.dissent: Silver royalty names embed a high beta to a single metal (silver), whose price is vulnerable to a global macro selloff or a USD spike on the unscheduled-news-heavy backdrop (unscheduled_share 0.88) — silver can gap down harder than diversified gold miners.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO closes below its 50-day moving average while Gold Miners' breadth drops below 0.6 before 20 trading days elapse

theses.subject: Pipelines & Midstream
theses.thesis: Pipelines & Midstream ranks 6 with a negative score (-0.125) but is still eligible (trend-gate passes), yet breadth is 0.0 — no internal cohesion — and durability_bar is only 0.52. The negative score plus zero breadth suggests the trend leg is not confirmed by participation; the lean is a de-prioritization relative to the stronger precious-metal complex, not a short or fade.
evidence: breadth 0.0 (no breadth confirmation of the trend)
rank 6 of 16, below the top energy/precious clusters
theses.dissent: Pipelines are rate-sensitive, high-yield instruments; if the macro backdrop shifts to a dovish monetary pivot, yield-chasing inflows could revive the group rapidly and the trend gate would keep it eligible despite weak breadth.

falsifier.text: XUT.TO-style midstream basket regains positive 10-day breadth above 0.5 while Pipelines & Midstream's score turns positive before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers is eligible and ranks 4, but is the only theme in the top half flagged as crowded (crowding_z 1.29, crowded=true). The guardrails are explicit: crowding is a SIZE-DOWN caution only, never a fade or sell. As a direction, 'avoid' here means do not add to this theme's leadership because the crowding flag suggests late-stage participation — a cautionary lean, not a short.
evidence: crowded true (crowding_z 1.29 — the only crowded theme)
theses.dissent: Energy is a beta-to-macro trade; if oil supply disruption dominates headlines (geopolitics is the top macro narrative with n=12), XEG.TO could gap higher and keep trending despite crowding — crowding alone has no basket-level forward edge.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO breaks out to a 20-day relative high against the S&P/TSX while Oil & Gas Producers' breadth holds above 0.85 before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
